**Tip (E036, commit 60645dd).** 231 steps at batch 2000. Resolution 20/24/28/32 px at 30/10/30/30% of steps. Whitening detached from 20%; stem frozen at 75%. Time is 5.29–5.34 s across 4 runs (E036, E038, E043, E044's base path), so time is reproducible to about 1%.

**Accuracy reality.**
- Seeds 0–2 on the same commit: E036 0.7532, E038 0.7525 on its own pass, E043 0.7497. E044's recal variant scored 0.7519.
- Rebuilds pick different autotuned kernels, so per-seed results are not bit-stable across builds. The rebuild-plus-seed spread on the 3-seed mean is about ±0.25 pp.
- The tip's population mean is about 0.752 (pooled fresh seeds 13–22: 0.7538, but the 0–2 reruns sit lower).
- Gate pass probability for a null change is about 35–40%. 3-seed keep/discard is mostly a coin flip. Only 20-seed comparisons on unselected seeds (SE about 0.07 pp) or paired before/after designs carry signal.
- My E035 and E043 accuracy misses both came from treating identical commits as identical outcomes. Widen ranges: no recipe forecast should be narrower than ±0.3 pp.

**Time model.** Time ≈ 0.25 s fixed + Σ steps × per-step cost. It has hit 15 of the last 16 runs.
- Per step: 32 px 0.032 s, 28 px 0.026, 24 px 0.021, 20 px 0.016.
- Discounts: whitening detach −8%; stem freeze −27%, leaving about 0.0235 s per frozen 32 px step.
- A batch-1000 step at 20 px costs about 0.0095 s, because overhead per step is fixed (Muon NS on all filters, launches, Lookahead). Halving the batch therefore costs about +20% for that phase.
- A conv1-only freeze saved under 1% (E042), so Cin=24 is not a hotspot.
- E044: BN recalibration cost about +0.03 s.

**Exchange rates (s saved per pp lost):**
- Early steps / epochs: about 1–2.5 (E041, E020, E023).
- Freeze at 75%: about 2. Freeze at 60%: about 0.65 (E037 cliff).
- Width: about 0.7 (E021).
- Selection: about 2.3 (E031). It saves more than its step share, about 1.2× the time fraction.
- Group-2 late freeze: estimated −0.15 to −0.2 s for −0.1 to −0.2 pp.

**Funders.** Every trajectory booster tested on held-out seeds has come out ≤0: E025, E029, E030, E032. E044's paired recal result was not in results.tsv; the 3-seed number shows no visible gain. Prior for any new booster: −0.05 ± 0.2 pp.

**Mechanisms**
1. Lookahead is worth about 1 pp and is near-tuned (E005, E025, E030).
2. Accuracy accrues across the whole run, with 28/32 px most valuable. The stem must train until about 70–75% of steps (E018, E024, E037, E040, E041).
3. Large-map work is bandwidth-bound; small maps scale sublinearly with MACs (E021, E028).
4. In the code, Muon filters are renormalized every step (wd has no effect on them) and NS already uses 3 iterations. So H1.5.4 and H1.2.3 are settled by the code.
5. Step-overhead floor: about 0.006–0.007 s per step regardless of batch. Levers that add steps pay it; levers that remove steps save it.

**Noise.** Per-seed std about 0.3 pp. Effective 3-seed spread about ±0.25 pp. 20-seed SE about 0.07 pp. Time noise about 1%.

**Strategy.** The tip sits about 0.2 pp above the 40-seed bar, with no proven funder. Remaining cuts (selection 95%, group-2 freeze, 20/28/32 schedule) each cost about 0.1–0.2 pp. The tip can absorb at most one of them, and only if fresh-seed 20-seed means confirm the tip is at about 0.7535.

**Unsure**
- Whether the PCIe judge discounts bandwidth-bound savings.
- Whether extra early steps buy accuracy (I068). My prior is a small gain that costs more time than it buys.

W3 (cost lens), after E044.

**Tip (E036, commit 60645dd).** 231 steps at batch 2000. Resolution 20/24/28/32 px at 30/10/30/30% of steps. Whitening detached from 20%; stem frozen at 75%. Time is 5.29–5.34 s across 4 runs (E036, E038, E043, E044's base path), so time is reproducible to about 1%.

**Accuracy reality.**
- Seeds 0–2 on the same commit: E036 0.7532, E038 0.7525 on its own pass, E043 0.7497. E044's recal variant scored 0.7519.
- Rebuilds pick different autotuned kernels, so per-seed results are not bit-stable across builds. The rebuild-plus-seed spread on the 3-seed mean is about ±0.25 pp.
- The tip's population mean is about 0.752 (pooled fresh seeds 13–22: 0.7538, but the 0–2 reruns sit lower).
- Gate pass probability for a null change is about 35–40%. 3-seed keep/discard is mostly a coin flip. Only 20-seed comparisons on unselected seeds (SE about 0.07 pp) or paired before/after designs carry signal.
- My E035 and E043 accuracy misses both came from treating identical commits as identical outcomes. Widen ranges: no recipe forecast should be narrower than ±0.3 pp.

**Time model.** Time ≈ 0.25 s fixed + Σ steps × per-step cost. It has hit 15 of the last 16 runs.
- Per step: 32 px 0.032 s, 28 px 0.026, 24 px 0.021, 20 px 0.016.
- Discounts: whitening detach −8%; stem freeze −27%, leaving about 0.0235 s per frozen 32 px step.
- A batch-1000 step at 20 px costs about 0.0095 s, because overhead per step is fixed (Muon NS on all filters, launches, Lookahead). Halving the batch therefore costs about +20% for that phase.
- A conv1-only freeze saved under 1% (E042), so Cin=24 is not a hotspot.
- E044: BN recalibration cost about +0.03 s.

**Exchange rates (s saved per pp lost):**
- Early steps / epochs: about 1–2.5 (E041, E020, E023).
- Freeze at 75%: about 2. Freeze at 60%: about 0.65 (E037 cliff).
- Width: about 0.7 (E021).
- Selection: about 2.3 (E031). It saves more than its step share, about 1.2× the time fraction.
- Group-2 late freeze: estimated −0.15 to −0.2 s for −0.1 to −0.2 pp.

**Funders.** Every trajectory booster tested on held-out seeds has come out ≤0: E025, E029, E030, E032. E044's paired recal result was not in results.tsv; the 3-seed number shows no visible gain. Prior for any new booster: −0.05 ± 0.2 pp.

**Mechanisms**
1. Lookahead is worth about 1 pp and is near-tuned (E005, E025, E030).
2. Accuracy accrues across the whole run, with 28/32 px most valuable. The stem must train until about 70–75% of steps (E018, E024, E037, E040, E041).
3. Large-map work is bandwidth-bound; small maps scale sublinearly with MACs (E021, E028).
4. In the code, Muon filters are renormalized every step (wd has no effect on them) and NS already uses 3 iterations. So H1.5.4 and H1.2.3 are settled by the code.
5. Step-overhead floor: about 0.006–0.007 s per step regardless of batch. Levers that add steps pay it; levers that remove steps save it.

**Noise.** Per-seed std about 0.3 pp. Effective 3-seed spread about ±0.25 pp. 20-seed SE about 0.07 pp. Time noise about 1%.

**Strategy.** The tip sits about 0.2 pp above the 40-seed bar, with no proven funder. Remaining cuts (selection 95%, group-2 freeze, 20/28/32 schedule) each cost about 0.1–0.2 pp. The tip can absorb at most one of them, and only if fresh-seed 20-seed means confirm the tip is at about 0.7535.

**Unsure**
- Whether the PCIe judge discounts bandwidth-bound savings.
- Whether extra early steps buy accuracy (I068). My prior is a small gain that costs more time than it buys.
- The true population mean of the tip: somewhere in 0.751–0.7535.

forecasts.reason: Doubling the step count in the 20 px phase pays the fixed per-step overhead about 69 extra times (+0.2–0.3 s). Any gain is likely ≤0.15 pp, below 3-seed resolution and worse than the epoch dial's rate.

Removing group-2 backward from about 23 frozen steps saves about 0.008 s each, plus the anneal, so about −0.17 s. Expected cost is about 0.1–0.2 pp, which sits at the edge of the 0.1 pp tolerance and within noise.

The recipe is unchanged, so the numbers are a rebuild draw. E042's under-1% saving from the conv1 freeze suggests conv1 is not below half the efficiency of group 2 and does not take ≥10% of step time.
About 11 fewer steps at E031's 1.2× time leverage gives about −5%. The likely loss is about 0.1–0.15 pp, borderline against the ≤0.1 pp tolerance at a 20-seed SE of 0.07.
cuDNN already pads small Cin internally, and E042 showed conv1 is cheap, so the time change will be under 1% versus the ≥2% claimed.

cruxes: What is the tip's true population mean on 20 unselected seeds (13–32)? If it is ≥0.7535, one 0.15 pp time cut (selection at 95% or the group-2 freeze) is affordable. If it is ≤0.752, nothing is affordable without a funder.
How much of a batch-2000 step is fixed overhead (Muon NS, launches, Lookahead) versus pixel-proportional work? This sets whether batch changes (I068, H5.1.x) gain or lose time.
Did E044's paired recalibration show any positive delta on seeds 13–32? This is the only clean funder candidate left.
